firm: Long & Long Injury Attorneys | Serving Alabama
qualification_reason: No meaningful main-service page gap: Long & Long has an extensive service-specific architecture with dedicated pages for its major advertised case types, including car/truck/motorcycle accidents, slip and fall, medical malpractice, workers' compensation, wrongful death and insurance bad faith.
campaign_notes: Live-site validation completed 2026-09-04. The firm presents a broad personal-injury case-type inventory, but the major services are not forced to share a single general page. Dedicated service pages were independently verified for Car Accidents, Slip and Fall, Medical Malpractice, Workers' Compensation, Wrongful Death and Insurance Bad Faith, with additional location/service pages across the site. This is the opposite of the structural gap targeted by the campaign. Decision-maker/email research was skipped because the service-page validation gate failed.
